experiment: RIBO-ATLAS-FM Wave E: masked-LM continued pretraining of official RNA-FM (rna-fm 0.2.2, RNA-FM_pretrained.pth) on Rfam 15.1 seed sequences, family/clan-held-out split
global_batch_note: identical sequences, masks and loss normalisation at every world size; RNA-FM's own pretraining update was 10,240 sequences (32 x 5 GPUs x update_freq 64)
total_steps_note: 60 timing steps (10 untimed + 50 timed) followed by 12 steps = ceil(92,684 train sequences / 8,192), i.e. about one more epoch; phase-1 scaling runs stop after step 60 on the same schedule, so their first 60 steps are the same computation as phase 2

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: linear warm-up then cosine to lr_final_fraction*lr_peak at total_steps

masking.count_rule: k = max(1, floor(0.15*L + 0.5)) nucleotide positions per sequence, uniformly without replacement (counter-based hash of seed, stream position, residue index)

precision: bf16 autocast (torch.autocast), fp32 master weights and optimizer state, fp32 cross-entropy
attention_note: official = unmodified fm.modules.TransformerLayer (need_weights=True, explicit softmax attention); sdpa = need_weights=False so torch.nn.functional.multi_head_attention_forward dispatches to scaled_dot_product_attention (supplementary run only)

micro_batching.partition: step's sequences sorted by (length desc, stream position), snake-dealt over ranks; each rank chunks its share greedily

evaluation.mask: k(L) positions, all replaced by <mask>, counter-based hash of seed, dataset row and replicate (independent of world size and step)
evaluation.points: step 0, every epoch boundary ceil(k*n_train/global_batch) < total_steps, and total_steps

primary_endpoint.comparison: first evaluation step whose epochs_seen = step*global_batch/n_train >= 1.0 (step 12 = 1.061 epochs at 8,192 sequences/step and 92,684 training sequences) versus step 0
primary_endpoint.statistic: token-weighted masked-LM cross-entropy change (nats) and perplexity ratio, paired masks
primary_endpoint.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples of held-out families (primary family per sequence); group (clan/shared-sequence component) bootstrap as sensitivity
primary_endpoint.pre_specified: fixed before submission on 15 Oct 2026 (coordinator review); reported whatever its sign

secondary_endpoints.multi_epoch: heldout_family change at step 72 (about 6.4 epochs of a small, redundant corpus) versus step 0, explicitly labelled multi-epoch; the remaining epoch-boundary evaluations form the learning curve
secondary_endpoints.in_family: val_in_family change at the same steps (in-distribution contrast)

leakage_note: RNA-FM was pretrained on RNAcentral, which very likely already contains these Rfam seed sequences; the family/clan split controls leakage within Wave E continued pretraining only
length_policy: RNA-FM supports 1022 nt (1024 positions incl. <cls>/<eos>); dataset max 1014 nt; the trainer refuses any longer sequence (no cropping occurs)
